sections.title: Learning Representations
sections.draft:
Neural networks with many layers learn representations of raw data at several levels of abstraction [@lecun2015].

These layered models now set the pace for speech and image recognition across the field [@lecun2015].
claims: Deep networks learn layered representations of raw data.

sections.title: Measurement in Physics
sections.draft:
Measurement in quantum physics shapes what an observer is able to record about a system [@aspelmeyer2009].

Careful experimental design keeps that influence small enough to report honestly [@aspelmeyer2009].
claims: Quantum measurement shapes what an observer records.

sections.title: An Outbreak Case
sections.draft:
Genome sequencing identified a novel coronavirus in patients with pneumonia in Wuhan in late 2019 [@zhu2020].

The rapid sharing of that sequence let laboratories everywhere develop tests within weeks [@zhu2020].
claims: Sequencing identified a novel coronavirus in late 2019.
